study type: secondary analysis of a retrospective cohort study
exposure: Calcium channel blocker (CCB) use during labor
outcome: Labor progress (latent phase of labor, traverse times between dilations)
cohort: The study included 285 individuals with chronic hypertension who underwent vaginal delivery at a tertiary care center from January 2010 to December 2020, excluding those with prior uterine surgeries and a 5-minute Apgar score of less than 5.
finding: A calcium channel blocker may slow the latent phase of labor in individuals with chronic hypertension, particularly in nulliparous individuals.
